name: correction
description: The user corrects an earlier amount. Only the corrected value should remain.

turns.text: I take home $3,800 a month after tax. My rent is $1,400 a month and groceries are about $300 a month. I spend $120 a month on gas for my commute and $80 a month on streaming services. I have $2,500 in savings and no debt.
Sorry, I made a mistake earlier: my rent is actually $1,500, not $1,400.
